items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Stuff Smith he came in, see, and they all started call the big bands

ctx.x: This was in '30. And I said to Earl, hey, we got a kid here that can really sing, so she won the contest that night and Earl took her right away and then in '31 Jimmie Lunceford come to town and he made good and then

Erskine Hawkins' band came in and then Stuff Smith he came in, see, and they all started call the big bands and Harry James, this is at the Apollo Theatre, Harry James came in. What's the guy that died, trumpet player, just died. Louis Prima.
